title: Story Cards
pitch: Explore a tiny branching adventure through expressive animated cards and clear choices.
rules: A finite, validated story graph has choice nodes and three endings. Choices commit before transitions.
No generative backend or AI dependency. Text is authored, captions available and history readable.
Loading returns to a node/choice state, not a half-finished visual transition.
content: Twelve story nodes, three endings, two characters and replayable choices.
